title: Chess.com review provenance for matched tactics
scope: 48 matched cases only; no rating fields or rating analysis.

settings_provenance.notes: Collector-B game JSON explicitly stores review_settings:null and says settings were not displayed and were not inferred from Analysis engine depth. Collector-A checks JSON stores labels, node/SAN, FEN, pieces, URL/capture time and board verification but no settings/engine/depth/platform/version or displayed eval fields. Local before_depth/after_depth and local Stockfish profile in MATCHED-CASES/PROTOCOL are not Chess.com review settings.

eval_comparison_method.displayed_eval_orientation: Chess.com saved displayed evaluation is treated as white-perspective; converted to mover perspective by multiplying by +1 if fen_before side to move is white, otherwise -1. Displayed decimal is rounded to centipawns.
eval_comparison_method.local_value: current_features.after_cp, in mover perspective from local Stockfish analysis.
eval_comparison_method.delta: displayed mover-perspective centipawns minus local after_cp; cross-engine/snapshot comparison only, not equivalent analyses.

ui_pgn_agreement.note: Agreement assessed only where exact target ply has both evidence record types. Missing export NAG is not interpreted as a negative label. Adjacent-ply labels are excluded.

limitations: PGN NAG annotations preserve review labels but not Chess.com eval trajectory/settings.
Displayed evaluations are partial single-move snapshots: collector-A none; collector-B only a subset.
Comparison is descriptive across Chess.com displayed snapshots and a separate local Stockfish profile; differing engines, positions/snapshot timing, rounding, and review configuration are unrecorded.
Evidence rows are keyed by exact game_id and ply; visible UI node/SAN was retained where available. Export-only records lack selected-node metadata.
